source: Curated from Fextralife: https://dragonsdogma2.wiki.fextralife.com/Side+Quests and https://dragonsdogma2.wiki.fextralife.com/Quests (plus individual quest pages where linked). Edit this file to extend hints; max 3 short lines per quest.
global: Fextralife: (!) on the wiki index = time-sensitive — delay can fail or lock the quest.
Main checkpoints (Feast of Deception, A New Godsway, The Guardian Gigantus) remove or move NPCs; finish local side content before advancing if you care.
If a pawn has a hand icon on a quest in the log, set it Priority and use Go! — they guide; they won't route you via oxcarts.

lines: Opening main quest — follow the gaol escape.
Sets the tone for Vermund; no optional branches here.
Early main quest — Melve and first world loop.
Advancing main story unlocks more side content in Vernworth later.
Main quest — dragon encounter beats.
Travel at night is riskier; camp or inn to skip time safely.
In the castle, guard Norman asks if you saw Sven — LIE if you want The Ornate Box later (wiki + community).
This choice is easy to miss; one wrong answer locks marketplace Sven content.
Board / captain-style culling tasks in Vernworth.
Usually daytime NPCs at the guild or barracks area.
Main political thread in Vernworth.
Advancing this line opens Nameless Village and related rumors.
Main quest — frees Waldhar / vault access.
Needed for some grimoires and scholar follow-ups (Spellbound / Appraisal chain).
Main-adjacent — unlocks eastern forest hub.
Required context for Till Death Do Us Part rumor chain.
PoNR #1 (Coronation): many Vernworth side quests vanish after this (wiki Quests page).
Wiki: Sven leaves the market; Ornate Box, Margit line, banquet-only NPCs — finish first.
Cannot undo; keep a separate save if unsure.
Battahl main gate arc.
Prepare curatives and heat gear before long desert legs.

journey to battahl: Head toward Battahl — use Brant's entry permit at the border checkpoint.

lines: Main Battahl arc — godsway / blue crystal investigation. Not time-sensitive.
Dragonforged at Bay Wayside Shrine is optional lore — oracle Luz is required for progress.
Luz unlocks Trickster Vocation; Rivage Elder cutscene completes the quest.
step_order: seek information about larger blue crystal shards
seek he who was dragon forged in harve village

enter bakbattahl: Auto-starts after Nation of the Lambent Flame — enter Bakbattahl gates.
Pathfinder cutscene: Forbidden Magick Research Laboratory holds godsway secrets.
speak with ambrosius: Olta'Battahl Coast — north from Dye Stores, northeast coastal path.
Collect Small Blue Crystal Shard on beach rocks; hand to Ambrosius (+100G).
He sends you to the oracle or The Dragonforged for larger shards.
seek information about larger blue cryst: Optional: Bay Wayside Shrine — coast cave, left fork — ask Dragonforged about godsway.
Required: Reverent Shrine (Enoa'Battahl Forest north) — speak to oracle Luz.
Oxcart to Checkpoint Rest Town works; fight/griffin nests along forest route.
seek he who was dragon forged in harve v: Harve Village — Rivage Elder's Home at southwest edge (Stormwind Cave).
Late day: elder rests until morning (auto time skip).
Cutscene: sunken temple rises — leads into Convergence.

lines: PoNR #2 (wiki): locks Tensions on the Highroad and Welcome to Battahl if not done.
Check open side tabs before turning this in.
Late main beat in Battahl (wiki PoNR #3 bucket for many side quests).
Several Battahl / volcanic sides must be cleared before this if you want 100%.
Endgame branch — true ending routes to Unmoored World (wiki).
Inn saves / return to base game may be limited; finish loose ends first.
Flora outside Auriol's shop — Fruit Roborant fetch.
Wiki Ornate Box: completing this lowers Auriol's box price (800 vs 1000 G).
Fextralife Side Quests: marked (!) — time-sensitive.
Borderwatch / Hugo recruit line; don't leave it hanging across long skips.
Castle / gate provisioner fetch quest.
Best done before Feast of Deception (wiki Vermund bucket 1).
Small hamlet NW of Borderwatch — saurian nest cleanup.
Low level; good early XP before pushing main to Vernworth.
Glyndwr & Lyle twins — archer line splits into Gift of the Bow / Trial.
Do both twins' arcs before PoNR if you want full rewards.
Battahl volcanic ravine rescue / escort style.
Heat + fall damage — bring padding or Mage levitate.

rescue the traveler: Speak to the trapped traveler in the volcanic ravine south of Bakbattahl.
Heat and fall damage — bring padding or Mage levitate.
escort the traveler: Escort them out of the ravine — watch for heat and falls.
return to safety: Get both of you to safe ground to complete the quest.

speak to margit: Hear Oswald's rumor first (fountain, Noble Quarter) — needs Nameless Village done.
Margit is outside Watchhead's Home in Vernworth north.
Pick 'Tell her of Ser Ludolph's plot' then accept the rescue.
aid gregor: Rush to Illdoers' Resting Place in Misty Marshes (northwest of Vernworth).
Bring camping kit + Wakestones. DO NOT kill the Dullahan — deal enough damage to make it FLEE.
Keep Gregor alive (heal/buff/revive). Kill = quest fail or bad outcome.
report back: Talk to Gregor after the Dullahan flees, then return to Margit to finish.
4 in-game day timer once started — prioritize this quest.

lines: Return to Melve for saurian attack (wiki Harve/Melve list).
Gateway into Ulrika romance — Readvent of Calamity triggers on next Melve visit.
Slums / Stardrop-adjacent beggar chain.
Gift or follow prompts across several days; check day vs night spawns.
Cathedral bell quest — ties to Nation's Death Knell copies (wiki Spellbound notes).
Don't brick this before giving away both original Nation's Death Knells to Trysha/Myrddin.
Fextralife Battahl list: (!) time-sensitive.
Highroad oxcart at night — follow quietly or fight ambush; failing timer may lock rewards.
Gracious Hand vaults scholar line post-Caged Magistrate.
Unlocks Waldhar move for Towering Earth grimoire (Spellbound wiki).

medicinal: Bring 3 Miasmite to Elena (farm phantoms at night if you don't have any).
After handing them over, follow Elena on her rounds.
follow: Stay with Elena until Lubomir sends you to investigate the Gracious Hand.
investigate the gracious hand: Talk to Lottie cleaning outside the Gracious Hand.
Return to Lubomir; accept his request to check the basement.
Basement door is on the right side of the building — usually NIGHT only or it's locked.
Downstairs: left room, curtain at the back — grab Records of Treatment + Unlabeled Medicine.
gather evidence: After both basement items, map points you to Walter's Tavern — talk to Bruno and Jehan.
Optional: catch Elena's night meeting with Alois, then show evidence to Lubomir.
Take Unlabeled Medicine to Radcliff in Checkpoint Rest Town (oxcart helps); wait a day, get his report, THEN arrest Elena.
In basement: grab/pin Elena. Best ending needs Radcliff's proof first.
report back to lubomir: Show Lubomir what you found; he may send you to the doctor at Checkpoint Rest Town.

lines: Merchant quarter fetch / donation loop.
Daytime NPCs — rest till noon if missing.

visit the manor: Noble Quarter — Townsend's Estate. Talk to Diana at the door.
Sebastian wants a body double so he can leave without his mother noticing.
look-alike: Need The Gift of Giving done first.
Find Daphne at the slums tent by the Gracious Hand — escort her to the manor.
prepare: Give Sebastian: Detoxifying Decoction (or All Heal) + Waking Powder for drowsiness.
Give something that smells like cyclops — Rugged Bone works.
Wait a few in-game days, return to the manor for the ending.
return to the manor: Sebastian should be back from Melve with the Blue Sunbright flower.
If Daphne got kicked out, find Diana later at the slums tent for the twist.

exchange gifts: Banquet at Vernworth Hall at NIGHT — wear Courtly Tunic, Courtly Breeches, Eventide Mask.
Red-cape masked man gives you a staff — remember his face; he's the thief later.
Other guests give random gifts; you don't need to give anything back.
clear yourself: When guards announce a theft: drop the Paragon Staff behind the hall (small side room, behind screen by chest).
Then tackle the red-cape quest-giver. Best reward if staff is dropped first.
Or buy staff back later from Ibrahim in Checkpoint Rest Town if you dropped it.
suspicion: Do NOT leave the ball holding the staff — worst outcome, jail, no gold.

lines: Wiki: often listed post-Feast — if quest won't start, finish coronation first.
Lennart at market is a different pre-Feast quest (A Noble Exchange timing varies by guide).

journal_lines: You heard the Riddle of Eyes.
You have been tasked with retrieving the item of greatest value that can be found on the other side of the door indicated by the sphinx.
Provide a satisfactory answer to each of the riddles posed by the sphinx.
lines: Sphinx at Mountain Shrine (north of Vernworth, past Trevo Mine). SAVE before every riddle.
Wrong answers permanently remove rewards — wrong answer twice locks out Maistir Grimoire.
After defeating or leaving, Sphinx may relocate to Frontier Shrine (Battahl) for riddles 7-10.

answer the sphinx: Go to Mountain Shrine north of Vernworth (past Trevo Mine, up the mountain road).
SAVE before each riddle — wrong answers permanently lose that reward.
Riddle answers (Fextralife): Lantern, Time, Limerence, Godsbane Blade, Human, Wing, Wilted Flower, Seeker's Token, Pawn, your own Pawn.
reach the frontier shrine: Sphinx has moved to Frontier Shrine in Battahl — travel south through the border.
Bring all previous correct-answer rewards; continue where you left off.
answer remaining riddles: Complete remaining riddles at Frontier Shrine for final rewards.
Finishing all 10 riddles earns the Unmoored World key item via the Sphinx's chest.

lines: Hidden eastern forest village — tied to Disa's Plot progression.
Required context for Oswald rumor (Till Death) and Howling Blizzard trade.
Refugee in Vernworth / Stardrop thread.
Often night or weather gated — wiki day/night cycle tip.
step_order: find a place to call home

help the refugee: Speak to the displaced Battahl refugee near Vernworth slums or Stardrop Inn.
Try different times of day if NPC is missing.
find a place to call home: Secure a dwelling for the refugee family.
furnish the home: Bring requested items to make the home livable.

lines: Vocation guild frustration quest.
Switch vocations freely before turn-in if wiki recommends certain skills.
Fextralife Side Quests: (!) time-sensitive wolf hunt.
Checkpoint Rest Town area — don't fast-forward multiple days once started.

hunt the wolves: Speak to the hunter near Borderwatch or Melve about wolf attacks.
Time-sensitive — avoid long time skips once started.

lines: Volcanic island drunk sage (wiki Battahl quest list).
Often tavern at night — camp till evening if NPC missing.

find the sotted sage: Find the drunken sage in a Volcanic Island tavern (Bakbattahl area).
Camp until evening if he is not at the bar.
speak to the sotted sage: Talk to him at the tavern when he appears.
complete the sage's request: Fulfill his errand — usually a drink or item run.

lines: Fextralife: (!) Bakbattahl marketplace poisoning investigation.
Evidence order matters for best outcome — check wiki walkthrough before accusing.
Isaac wants a grimoire — overlaps loot with Spellbound / Appraisal.
Forge duplicates at Ibrahim so you don't brick parallel quests.
step_order: find the second volume of the grimoire

speak to isaac: Buy anything at Isaac's Wares in Bakbattahl to start.
He needs a Ripened Quince before he can keep reading.
find a ripened quince: Loot quince from goblins in western Battahl or buy one.
Rest 3 days on a bench in Bakbattahl to ripen it.
find the second volume of the grimoire: Buy On the Transference of Souls 2 from Ibrahim at Checkpoint Rest Town (2000 G).
give isaac the forged grimoire: Forge On the Transit of Souls 2 at Ibrahim (~2400 G) — give the FAKE to Isaac for the good ending.

lines: Vernworth sculptor inspiration quest.
Bring reference items from open world; wiki lists optional shortcuts.

help the sculptor: Klark's Estate, Vernworth Noble Quarter — talk to Klark outside.
visit fulvio in battahl: After Feast of Deception — Fulvio's Workshop in Bakbattahl.
accompany fulvio: Griffin nest northwest of Bakbattahl — prolong the fight so Fulvio can sketch.
wait for fulvio progress: Wait a few in-game days, then check Fulvio's workshop again.
attend the unveiling: Meet Fulvio at Klark's Estate in Vernworth for the sculpture reveal.

lines: Fextralife: (!) Battahl temple night investigation.
Stealth or combat branches — read wiki before choosing violence in the shrine.
Fextralife: (!) timed smith commission in Battahl.
Gather materials before accepting final timer if wiki warns.
Wiki Quests bucket: AFTER Feast — mother in Vernworth Castle.
Sven-adjacent loot chase; don't sell unique orb items mid-quest.

search the castle: Mother in Vernworth Castle — talk to her to start the hunt.
Check side rooms and upper floors.
find the jadeite orb: Orb is hidden in the castle — search containers thoroughly.
Do not sell unique orb loot mid-quest.
return the orb: Bring the jadeite orb back to the quest giver.

lines: Talk to oxcart drivers at stops — escort / parcel loop.
Oxcarts skip time — can accidentally push day-sensitive quests.
Harve Village Ulrika step — auto-starts when you speak to her there after Readvent.
Romance: daily gifts after this; wiki says max affinity before final Ulrika quest.

find out: Starts when Sven argues with Auriol in the marketplace.
If you lied to guard Norman during Seat of the Sovran, Sven recognizes you (better rewards).
Medicament Predicament done = Ornate Box costs 800g not 1000g.
recompense: Best: buy the box yourself (800g), give it to Sven at Roderick's shop steps.
Meet him at Dragon Fountain 4 days in a row for Jasper, Ring, Ferrystone, Courtly outfit.
Lending gold only pays 500g back — buying the box gives more rewards.
ornate box: Finish before Feast of Deception — Sven leaves the market forever after.
Normann (castle guard) gates this quest — lie for Sven in Seat of the Sovran.

lines: Moonglow Garden / slums cat training (wiki Side Quests regional list).
Carry / throw cats as NPC asks — low combat.

train the cats: Moonglow Garden / Vernworth slums — help train the cats.
Carry or throw cats as the owner asks.
complete cat training: Finish all training rounds the owner assigns.

lines: Melve warrior maister — Moonglow / Melve cluster on wiki index.
Requires warrior access — switch before talking if needed.
Stardrop intel from Brant — castle investigation (Sven political arc).
Not the same as Ornate Box market trigger — parallel Sven content.
Advances Wilhelmina rose quest prerequisites.
Continues Stolen Throne — castle / letter trail.
Keep manual saves; some branches affect Magisterial Amenity.
Late Sven castle favor chain.
Check inventory for requested luxuries before accepting timer steps.

find the spectacles: Search the masquerade hall in Vernworth Castle for exquisite spectacles.
return the spectacles to waldhar: Deliver the spectacles to Waldhar in the archive beneath the Gracious Hand.
Gracious Hand vault — scholar line from Caged Magistrate.

lines: Fextralife Quests list: (!) — 3-day murder-report phase after romance fork.
Wilhelmina only at Rose Chateau top floor 8PM–6AM (wiki).
Peephole choice: 'Offer assistance' — 'Dissuade' bricks romance (wiki).
Glyndwr wants a specific bow — check blacksmith stock / craft.
Leads directly into Trial of Archery — do back-to-back.
Shoot targets with Glyndwr — Archer or hybrid helps.
Unlocks Sacred Arbor / Doireann line (Ailing Arborheart).

shoot the targets: Speak to Glyndwr after Gift of the Bow.
Shoot the archery targets — Archer vocation helps.
complete the archery trial: Hit all targets in the trial course to finish.

lines: Sacred Arbor — wiki: finish before Out of the Forest, Into the Forge or risk lock.
Needs Battahl access for late objective — plan route before PoNRs.
Elvish pawn specialization auto-translates (wiki Pawns page).
Fextralife: (!) post-Feast elf forge quest in Battahl.
Completing can lock Ailing Arborheart if that was still open — order matters.
Heat prep + wakestones for boss adds.

repel the dragon: Return to Melve after Seat of the Sovran + Scaly Invaders progress.
Break red weakpoints on legs/neck — big stagger when knocked down.
Do NOT kill the dragon here (can break Mystic Spearhand maister later).
Let it flee at ~3rd health bar; talk to Ulrika after.
visit melve: Come back later — Ulrika at her house talks with Martin (treason accusation).
Stay the night if prompted; next morning she's gone.
find ulrika: She's at Harve Village southwest of Melve (starts Trouble on the Cape if new).
Talk to her there, then report back to Lennart in Melve.
inform lennart: Tell Lennart Ulrika moved to Harve — completes Readvent.
Finish before Feast of Deception or this line locks.

lines: Harve daytime Ulrika — needs max affinity (gifts till blush) for romance end.
Wiki: one gift per day rule still applies.
Final romance locks Beloved choice in Legacy.

speak with ulrika: Ulrika in Harve Village during the day (8am–10pm).
Max affinity with daily gifts before finishing for romance ending.

lines: Vernworth smith legacy quest — mid-game gear tutorial tone.
Bring ores from Battahl mines if wiki lists rare ingots.
step_order: find someone to repair the sword

speak to the smith: Roman at Vernworth Castle courtyard — Dulled Regalia Sword.
find someone to repair the sword: Brokkr's Smithy in Bakbattahl — Sara takes over when Brokkr refuses.
deliver glimmercoal to sara: Bring materials to Sara at Brokkr's Smithy.
return restored sword to roman: Mountain Base Cave forge sequence — return sword to Roman.

lines: Fextralife: auto on first border crossing; also in PoNR #2 bucket.
Locks if A New Godsway completed without doing it.
Prepare Beastren mask / forgeries if wiki route suggests.
Wiki How to Unlock: Eini & Eino must leave the house OR carry Trysha outside, then talk.
Same grimoires as Sorcerer's Appraisal — forge at Ibrahim; give Trysha ~3 originals for best maister outcome.
After tomes: don't kill Trysha in frenzy — tackle / Solemnity / Wakestone revive (wiki).
step_order: visit trysha after a few days
check on trysha after a few days

collect grimoires for trysha: Eini's Home north of Melve — grandparents must NOT be inside when you talk to Trysha.
Forge copies at Ibrahim; need tomes for Appraisal too.
bring trysha the grimoires: Give Trysha at least 3 original grimoires for maister rewards.
visit trysha after a few days: Return to Eini's Home — Trysha begins casting.
exhaust trysha's magick reserves: Don't kill Trysha — tackle / Solemnity / Wakestone revive.
check on trysha after a few days: Return again for Conjurer's Jottings and Enchanter's Almanac.

lines: Wiki: Myrddin attacks as TEST — do not kill; Wakestone + Courtly outfit tip.
Steal Let There Be Light from balcony, not inner stairs, or he aggros instantly.
Parallel to Spellbound — plan forgeries before handing originals away.
step_order: revisit myrddin after a few days

wear noble clothing: Courtly Tunic + Breeches (Ornate Box or Philbert's) before entering Myrddin's Home.
gather grimoires for myrddin: Same five tomes as Spellbound — forge at Ibrahim if needed.
Steal Let There Be Light from balcony, not inner stairs.
deliver grimoires to myrddin: Wear Turquoise Ring from Spellbound; give 3 grimoires.
revisit myrddin after a few days: Return for Myrddin's Chronicle (Maelstrom) and rewards.

lines: Volcanic island festival / dancer quest (wiki Battahl list).
Some steps are night-only — camp to dusk.

speak to the dancer: Dancer / performer in Bakbattahl — reviving an old festival.
Some steps are night-only — camp until dusk.
gather festival materials: Collect items the dancer requests for the revival.
attend the festival: Return at the scheduled time for the festival performance.

lines: Post-Feast Sven castle storyline (wiki Quests Vermund bucket 2).
If Ornate Box still open, Sven may be here instead of market — wiki Ornate Box note.
Completing locks some earlier Sven missables — check list before finale.
Volcanic coast lighthouse chain (wiki Battahl list).
Storms worsen at night — ship before weather turns.
Wiki Vermund Quests 2: only AFTER Feast of Deception (10140), before Guardian Gigantus (10170).
Checkpoint Rest Town — Toumi (feed twice), oxcart men, then Lyssandro.
Not available while Feast is still your active main quest.

feed toumi: Checkpoint Rest Town — boy Toumi by the blue tent past the inn.
Give him food twice (not rotten). Hugo may appear after the second feed.
speak to the oxcart men: Talk to the two men opposite the oxcart station after Toumi.
They point you toward Lyssandro about the Coral Snakes bandits.
speak to lyssandro: Lyssandro wears white robes near the oxcart waiting post.
Accept his request to hunt the Coral Snakes on the highroad.
find the coral snakes hideout: Head south on the main road from Checkpoint Rest Town.
Ask travelers on the road — one will flag the oxcart raid site.
storm the coral snakes hideout: Chase bandits into the southwest cavern hideout.
Fight through to the end — Hugo is left behind; quest completes.

lines: Fextralife: (!) Battahl highroad theft investigation.
Timed follow / stakeout segments — read wiki for safe tail distance.
Fextralife: both Quests page PoNR #2 list AND border escort.
Must finish before A New Godsway or disappears from log.
Oxcart from Vernworth can skip time — plan arrival before deadline.

escort on the highroad: Battahl border escort — finish BEFORE A New Godsway (10160).
Time-sensitive PoNR quest — plan oxcart travel carefully.

lines: Fextralife: (!) volcanic arena duel chain.
Boss rush style — stock curatives and stamina.
Co-op pawns with lightning resist help wiki-recommended fight.
